rules._help: Edit the scenario here, then start a new game. Existing saves must match the current rules. Dice fields are [number_of_dice, sides]. Money is silver shekels; metal quantities are minas.
rules.title: YATS · The Assur Caravan

tin.name: Tin
tin.description: Buy tin in Assur and sell it in Anatolia. One donkey carries 120 minas.

textile.name: Textiles
textile.description: Ordinary textiles. Exports from Assur must include both tin and textiles.

fine_textile.name: Fine textiles
fine_textile.description: Fine textiles are available only in Assur. Supply is limited and replenished in batches.

copper.name: Copper
copper.description: Buy copper in Durhumit and sell it in Purušhaddum. Rent a wagon to carry larger quantities.

iron.name: Iron
iron.description: Occasionally offered at the Euphrates crossing. You may buy iron at most twice per season. It may travel only on Smuggler’s Track.

assur.name: Assur
assur.subtitle: On the Tigris
assur.description: Buy donkeys, tin, and textiles here. Keep enough silver to pay travel costs and customs.
assur.report: Tin and textiles are available here. Tin prices usually rise after the early supply changes. Keep silver for travel costs.

euphrates.name: Euphrates crossing
euphrates.subtitle: The river crossing
euphrates.description: Sell your goods here, continue to Kaneš, or take Smuggler’s Track to Durhumit. The track carries a risk of arrest.
euphrates.report: Selling here takes less travel time but usually earns less than selling farther inland.

kanes.name: Kaneš
kanes.subtitle: Market and customs
kanes.description: Imported tin and textiles must clear customs on arrival. Sell here or continue to Durhumit or Purušhaddum.
kanes.report: Tin and textiles usually sell for more than at the Euphrates crossing. Allow for customs charges and clearance time.

durhumit.name: Durhumit
durhumit.subtitle: The copper market
durhumit.description: Sell imported goods, buy copper, and hire a wagon for the direct road to Purušhaddum.
durhumit.report: Imported goods usually sell for more than in Kaneš. Copper is available here for sale in Purušhaddum.

purushhaddum.name: Purušhaddum
purushhaddum.subtitle: The western market
purushhaddum.description: Sell imported goods and copper here. Wool contracts are available during days 90–120. Commodity sales are taxed.
purushhaddum.report: Imported goods usually sell for the highest prices here. Sales tax and the long journey reduce the return. Wool contracts are available on days 90–120.

routes.name: The western road
routes.description: This road crosses the Euphrates. Tolls and attacks can reduce your profit.

routes.name: The mountain road
routes.description: The most dangerous legal road. Unsealed imports require customs clearance when they arrive in Kaneš.

routes.name: The northern road
routes.description: A legal road between Kaneš and Durhumit.

routes.name: The western uplands
routes.description: A legal road between Kaneš and Purušhaddum.

routes.name: The copper road
routes.description: Rented copper wagons may use only this road.

routes.name: Smuggler’s Track
routes.description: Bypasses Kaneš and its customs. A patrol can arrest you and end the game.

log.title: Game begins
log.text: Returning trader receives an interest-free loan of 7200 shekels of silver. Caravans must arrive by day 207; final accounting is on day 232.

log.title: Departure
log.text: Left Assur for Euphrates crossing. The planned journey is 15 days, including any Kaneš clearance.

log.title: A discreet offer
log.text: A trader offers iron. You may buy iron at most 2 more times this season. The cargo must take Smuggler’s Track to Durhumit.

log.title: Arrival
